name: Yumemizuki Mizuki
mistakes: Leaving Dreamdrifter early: her Swirl bonuses only work while she floats.

sources.name: PawPixl explanations (Claude development session (checked against genshin-db 5.2.15 text))

abilities.name: Pure Heart, Pure Dreams
abilities.simple: Up to 3 Anemo attacks, an Anemo Charged Attack after a short cast, and a plunge.
abilities.canon:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 3 attacks, dealing Anemo DMG.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina and deals AoE Anemo DMG after a short casting time.

Plunging Attack
Calling upon the power of Anemo, she plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals AoE Anemo DMG upon impact with the ground.

abilities.name: Aisa Utamakura Pilgrimage
abilities.simple: Anemo damage and the Dreamdrifter state: she floats, attacks enemies with Anemo and buffs Swirl damage based on her Elemental Mastery.
abilities.canon:
Weaves memories of lovely dreams, entering a Dreamdrifter state where Yumemizuki Mizuki floats above the ground, and dealing 1 instance of AoE Anemo DMG to nearby opponents.

Dreamdrifter
·While in the Dreamdrifter state, Yumemizuki Mizuki will continuously drift forward, dealing AoE Anemo DMG to nearby opponents at regular intervals.
·During this time, Yumemizuki Mizuki can control her direction of drift, and the pick-up distance of Yumemi Style Special Snacks from the Elemental Burst Anraku Secret Spring Therapy will be increased.
·Increases the Swirl DMG and Stellar Swirl reaction DMG that nearby party members deal based on Yumemizuki Mizuki's Elemental Mastery.
·Dreamdrifter will end when Mizuki leaves the field or uses her Elemental Skill again.

abilities.name: Anraku Secret Spring Therapy
abilities.simple: Pulls in enemies with Anemo damage and summons a Mini Baku that follows the active character and creates snacks that heal or deal damage.
abilities.canon:
Summons forth countless lovely dreams and nightmares that pull in nearby objects and opponents, dealing AoE Anemo DMG and summoning a Mini Baku.

Mini Baku:
Follows the current active character. At regular intervals, the Mini Baku will create 1 Yumemi Style Special Snack nearby. After one of your own party members picks up a Special Snack, if their HP is higher than 70%, the Snack will explode and unleash a Munen Shockwave, dealing 1 instance of AoE Anemo DMG to nearby opponents. Otherwise, it will heal the character who picked it up based on Yumemizuki Mizuki's Elemental Mastery. When Yumemizuki Mizuki triggers healing by picking up a Yumemi Style Special Snack, the amount of healing is increased by 100%. If a Snack is not picked up after a period of time, it will explode and release a Munen Shockwave, dealing 1 instance of AoE Anemo DMG to surrounding opponents.

abilities.name: Bright Moon's Restless Voice
abilities.simple: Triggering Swirl or Stellar Swirl in Dreamdrifter extends its duration.
abilities.canon: When Yumemizuki Mizuki triggers a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction while in her Dreamdrifter state, Dreamdrifter's duration increases by 2.5s. This effect can trigger once every 0.3s for a maximum of 2 times per Dreamdrifter state.

abilities.name: Thoughts by Day Bring Dreams by Night
abilities.simple: In Dreamdrifter, when teammates hit with Pyro, Hydro, Cryo or Electro, she gains Elemental Mastery.
abilities.canon: While Yumemizuki Mizuki is in the Dreamdrifter state, when other nearby party members hit opponents with Pyro, Hydro, Cryo, or Electro attacks, her Elemental Mastery will increase by 100 for 4s.

abilities.name: All Ailments Banished
abilities.razor: Better food heals. Not for fighting.
abilities.simple: Party members sometimes recover extra HP from healing foods. A world perk.
abilities.canon: When Yumemizuki Mizuki is in the party, party members have a chance to recover 30% additional HP when using healing foods that do not have reviving properties. The trigger chance for this effect increases with the corresponding character's Friendship Level. (This effect will always trigger if the Traveler is the character consuming healing food.)

abilities.name: In Mist-Like Waters
abilities.simple: In Dreamdrifter she keeps applying Twenty-Three Nights’ Awaiting to nearby enemies for extra Swirl damage.
abilities.canon: When Yumemizuki Mizuki is in the Dreamdrifter state, she will continuously apply the "Twenty-Three Nights' Awaiting" effect to nearby opponents for 3s every 3.5s. When an opponent has a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction triggered against them by Anemo DMG while the aforementioned effect is active, the effect will be canceled, and this Swirl or Stellar Swirl instance deals DMG against this opponent increased by 1,100% and 550% of Mizuki's Elemental Mastery, respectively.

abilities.name: Your Echo I Meet in Dreams
abilities.simple: Entering Dreamdrifter gives the party elemental damage bonus based on her Elemental Mastery.
abilities.canon: When Yumemizuki Mizuki enters the Dreamdrifter state, every Elemental Mastery point she has will increase all nearby party members' Pyro, Hydro, Cryo, and Electro DMG Bonuses by 0.04% until the Dreamdrifter state ends.

abilities.name: Till Dawn's Moon Ends Night
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Aisa Utamakura Pilgrimage by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Aisa Utamakura Pilgrimage by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

abilities.name: Buds Warm Lucid Springs
abilities.simple: Picking up her Burst’s snacks deals damage and heals, and restores Energy.
abilities.canon: Picking up a Yumemi Style Special Snack from the Elemental Burst Anraku Secret Spring Therapy will both deal DMG and heal, and will restore 5 Energy to Yumemizuki Mizuki. Energy can be restored this way 4 times per Anraku Secret Spring Therapy duration.

abilities.name: As Setting Moon Brings Year's End
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Anraku Secret Spring Therapy by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Anraku Secret Spring Therapy by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

abilities.name: The Heart Lingers Long
abilities.simple: In Dreamdrifter, the party’s Swirl damage can crit.
abilities.canon: While Yumemizuki Mizuki is in the Dreamdrifter state, Swirl reaction DMG dealt by nearby party members can score CRIT Hits, with CRIT Rate fixed at 30%, and CRIT DMG fixed at 100%. Any Stellar Swirl reaction DMG dealt by these characters will also have its CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG increased by 10% and 20%, respectively.

fundamentals.simple: Mizuki’s Skill puts her in Dreamdrifter: she floats and Swirls, and teammates’ elemental hits extend it.
